WITH filtered_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.SchoolName,
    s.DOCType,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`,
    f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS diff
  FROM 
    frpm f
  JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE 
    f.`Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
    AND s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
    AND s.GSoffered = 'K-12'
    AND s.GSserved = 'K-12'
),
average_diff AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(diff) AS avg_diff
  FROM 
    filtered_data
)
SELECT 
  fd.SchoolName,
  fd.DOCType
FROM 
  filtered_data fd
JOIN 
  average_diff ad ON 1=1
WHERE 
  fd.diff > ad.avg_diff;	----- bird -----	california_schools

)

    SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption_2012
  FROM 
    customers
  JOIN

  WHERE 
    Date LIKE '2012%' 
    AND Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY 
    Segment
),
consumption_2013 AS (
  SELECT 
    Segment, 
    SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption_2013
  FROM 
    customers
  JOIN 
    yearmonth ON customers.CustomerID = yearmonth.CustomerID
  WHERE 
    Date LIKE '2013%' 
    AND Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY 
    Segment
)

  c2012.Segment,
  (c2013.total_consumption_2013 - c2012.total_consumption_2012) AS increase,
  ((c2013.total_consumption_2013 - c2012.total_consumption_2012) / c2013.total_consumption_2013) * 100 AS percentage_increase
FROM 
  consumption_2012 c2012
JOIN 
  consumption_2013 c2013 ON c2012.Segment = c2013.Segment
ORDER BY 
  percentage_increase DESC, 
  percentage_increase ASC
LIMIT 1, 1;	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing

WITH customer_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    t.CustomerID,
    y.Consumption AS consumption_2012,
    y2.Consumption AS consumption_2013
  FROM 
    transactions_1k t
  JOIN 
    yearmonth y ON t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID AND STRFTIME('%Y', y.Date) = '2012'
  JOIN 
    yearmonth y2 ON t.CustomerID = y2.CustomerID AND STRFTIME('%Y', y2.Date) = '2013'
  WHERE 
    t.Date = '2012-08-25' AND t.Amount = 634.8
)
SELECT 
  consumption_2012,
  consumption_2013,
  (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM 
  customer_transactions;	----- bird -----	debit_card_specializing
